resources.string: Uses qualified system GPS, fused or network positions without original-navigation DR. Applies at the next connection.

Uses GPS with accuracy within 30 m and age within 2 seconds. Falls back to DR when GPS fails, then other system sources. While DR is valid, requires 5 consecutive new qualified GPS samples to switch back; an invalid sample resets the count. If DR also fails, one qualified GPS sample restores location. Applies at the next connection.
Uses original-navigation DR first, then qualified system location if DR is invalid or has no update for 2 seconds. DR includes position, heading and speed. Applies at the next connection.
Uses only qualified GPS; reports no fix when GPS is unavailable, older than 3 seconds or less accurate than 30 m. Applies at the next connection.
Uses only original-navigation DR position, heading and speed. Reports no fix when DR is invalid or has no update for 2 seconds. Applies at the next connection.
